article.hook: Someone keeps steering the conversation back to their wins. The South Node in Leo pulls us past the urge to perform for applause. It’s a long haul - more than a year of letting that go.
article.lived: For eighteen months, the old need to be center stage flickers up in meetings, parties, and online threads. You’ll notice people circling back to ‘remember when I...’ stories or showing off like it’s a lifeline. The transit plays out in moments when ego-driven flashes want to take over a group’s rhythm, dragging us toward rehearsed roles instead of raw connection.
article.turn: The problem hits when that spotlight craving turns defensive or resentful. Complaining about not getting your due, interrupting to reclaim attention, or pushing for applause breaks the flow and drains collective energy. You can’t build trust by demanding a throne.
moves: Leave one brag unsaid in a conversation this week.
Hand the mic to someone quieter and stay silent till they finish.
Make one decision without the need to get credit for it.
